title: UK design-system and Home Assistant control crosswalk
scope: Direct component/pattern catalogue entries from the eight initial named systems, plus Publishing frontend templates and the subsequently identified Royal Navy Components Storybook namespace; brand foundations and all 38 documented HA families. Supplemental departmental discovery is recorded separately. This is not an exhaustive inventory of every UK public-sector design system, a claim that every detail page was read, or evidence that every native HA surface was modified.
inventory_method: Official indexes opened and linked names/URLs recorded; one level per catalogue, except Home Office named query routes and grouped pattern paths. Royal Navy Components titles are deduplicated across docs and variant stories. Descendant examples, non-component Storybook namespaces, historical/community prototypes and supplemental directory discoveries are not added to catalogue-entry counts.

decision_definitions.adopted: A named bounded civica implementation explicitly uses the pattern; this does not transfer certification.
decision_definitions.adapted: Use the identified principle with explicit HA changes.
decision_definitions.no-direct-equivalent: The full HA task/control has no equivalent in these reviewed catalogues; use a native/local contract with cited supporting primitives.
decision_definitions.not-applicable: Out-of-scope identity/domain requirement or retired source; not an implementation gap.
decision_definitions.mapped-reference: A previously published local reference page owns this source; runtime status remains separate.
decision_definitions.mapped-principle: The source is linked to an HA task-family decision; its package is not necessarily installed.
decision_definitions.not-selected: Listed for inventory completeness, but no new adoption or full detail review is claimed.

systems.name: Royal Navy Design System

items.title: Alert
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Keep the existing notification/status owners; distinguish an actionable alert from a transient message. The RN component has not had a detail review.

items.title: Autocomplete
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Keep the existing search-input and native eligible-entity picker contracts. A matching component name is not evidence that RN handles HA targets or selected sets.

items.title: Avatar
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Use the existing person/presence privacy contract. An avatar must not imply identity, occupancy or permission; no RN avatar styling is adopted.

items.title: Badge
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Retain the already bounded MoJ notification-badge owner. Do not stack another badge style or equate unread counts with ordinary entity state.

items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Prefer the existing GOV.UK-derived breadcrumb owner for hierarchical navigation; no RN replacement is needed.

items.title: Button
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Prefer the existing GOV.UK button owner and native action semantics; RN package adoption would duplicate the primitive.

items.title: Checkbox
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Prefer the existing GOV.UK checkbox owner for multiple independent selections; actual capability and schema remain native.

items.title: Classification Bar
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Military information-classification presentation has no demonstrated household need in this review. Do not imply an official security classification or reuse it for household status.

items.title: Compound Timeline
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Keep native History/statistics and schedule contracts. This name does not establish an equivalent event source, time-zone model or trace editor; no detail review or import claimed.

items.title: Context Menu
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Retain native contextual actions with visible, keyboard-reachable alternatives. Existing navigation/action guidance remains owner; RN menu behaviour has not been inspected.

items.title: Data Grid
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Prefer the existing table and native registry bulk-action contracts. A richer grid requires independent editing, selection, keyboard and permission evidence.

items.title: Date Picker
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Retain precise date entry and native calendar semantics. The RN picker is a candidate reference, not a verified replacement for recurrence or time zones.

items.title: Description List
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Prefer the existing GOV.UK summary-list owner for labelled readings, retaining units and freshness.

items.title: Dialog
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Keep the shared dialog owner and native focus/confirmation semantics. No second RN dialog implementation is adopted.

items.title: Dismissible Banner
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Use the existing banner owner; dismissing a message must not falsely acknowledge or resolve the underlying device condition.

items.title: Drawer
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Retain native side-panel and navigation interaction. A drawer is not automatically a modal; focus, escape and narrow layouts need component-specific evidence before adaptation.

items.title: List
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Retain semantic lists and native entity-row actions. An RN generic list does not replace a to-do state machine or capability-specific row.

items.title: Masthead
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Prefer the civica.uk header and supplied artwork. Do not import the RN service identity or classified-service presentation.

items.title: Modal
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Use the existing dialog owner, with a deliberate trigger, accessible name, focus return and explicit action consequences. No parallel modal family is introduced.

items.title: Navigation Card
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Prefer existing cards/action links; keep real destinations and avoid a nested interactive whole-card target.

items.title: Number Input
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed

items.title: Phase Banner
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Prefer the existing phase-banner owner for a service phase, not device availability or update progress.

items.title: Popover
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed

items.title: Progress Bar

items.title: Progress Indicator

items.title: Radio
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Prefer existing GOV.UK radios for one choice from supported options; no duplicate RN primitive is needed.

items.title: Range Slider

items.title: Select

items.title: Sidebar
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Keep the current bounded civica sidebar adapter and native navigation ownership; no RN sidebar or service branding is imported.

items.title: Switch
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Retain native Boolean state/action semantics and the existing controls owner. A switch is not suitable for an unconfirmed one-off command merely because its appearance is compact.

items.title: Tab Nav
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed

items.title: Tab Set

items.title: TablePagination

items.title: Text Area
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Prefer the existing GOV.UK textarea owner; structured automation/code editors and conversation actions retain their own semantics.

items.title: Text Input
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Prefer the existing GOV.UK text-input owner for exact values and validation; no duplicate RN field styling is adopted.

items.title: Toast
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Keep the existing feedback owner with a persistent route for important results. A transient toast is not physical confirmation or the sole error explanation.

items.title: Tooltip
items.review_depth: catalogue-entry and existing local-owner comparison; upstream detail behaviour not reviewed
items.reason: Keep essential instructions as persistent hint text and native accessible names. RN Tooltip is a candidate for supplementary help only; hover-only text must not carry required information.
